name: Arizuka Jin
source:
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

Arizuka Jin is one of the participants in [url=https://vndb.org/c14476]Odin[/url]'s Ragnarök. Despite his young appearance, Jin is in fact the Game Master of Ragnarök, being able to call forth Eye Space and change the rules at will. Unlike most participants, he does not have something to protect but rather, wants to prove that he is more powerful than Odin.

[spoiler]Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Jin is the self-proclaimed King of the Mahoutsukai, and his abilities has the power to prove it. Having been the Game Master and one of the participants of the last Mahoutsukai War, he has polished his abilities from the previous experiences he gained and is still in the process of further improving them. Although his ego led him to look down upon others once, his outlook on others have started to change little by little since his defeat in the war. Jin admires people who are strong, so that his strong ambitions would allow him to challenge and surpass them.

Among the "Mahoutsukai", Jin's abilities, in which others would call foul play, are very useful in battle. Jin is given the title "Chrono Kairos" in order to set him apart from the other Mahoutsukai. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853984]Getchu[/url]][/spoiler]
